name: Whisperwood Elemental
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, manifest the top card of your library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Sacrifice this creature: Until end of turn, face-up nontoken creatures you control gain "When this creature dies, manifest the top card of your library."
blocked_sentences: Sacrifice this creature: Until end of turn, face-up nontoken creatures you control gain "When this creature dies, manifest the top card of your library."

needs.what: a selector key that matches permanents by face-up/face-down status (e.g. `face_down: false` for "face-up creatures"), so an effect's objects can be narrowed to face-up nontoken creatures you control and exclude manifested/cloaked/morphed face-down permanents
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has `is_token`, `types` and `controller` but nothing reads face-down status; `face_down` exists only as an option on zone-moving ops (exile, look_at_top, search_library), not as a filter. Using `is_token: false` alone would also grant the dies-trigger to face-down manifests, a different card
